claims: Libraries, devices, fonts and locale catalogs are named by path.
LOCK keeps libraries, fonts and catalogs resident; devices may be preloaded but cannot be locked.
UNLOCK permits a resource to be flushed.
documentation_boundary.evidence: documentation-only; selected Workbench 3.1 guest behavior remains open

bounded_code_observations: Requests locale.library, dos.library, utility.library and graphics.library during startup, with version floors in the high thirties; a diskfont.library V37 message is embedded for the font catalog path.
Parses a multiple NAME argument and LOCK/UNLOCK switches through DOS ReadArgs.
Uses the current CLI/process context and DOS resource/file APIs to enumerate named resources, report already-locked or not-locked states, and manage resource locks.
Contains catalog-oriented strings for Library, Device, Font, Catalog and a LoadResource requester/title, plus formatted success and failure diagnostics.
Contains a font-catalog path that constructs a TextAttr and calls diskfont.library, graphics.library and utility.library helpers.
evidence_limits: No original guest execution has established resource-list selection, lock/unlock state transitions, multiple-argument result precedence, diagnostics, catalog behavior or IoErr precedence.
The media protection word has P clear; runtime PURE/resident behavior remains unobserved.
This audit does not authorize copying the original binary or claiming shipping equivalence.
